prompt:
Panoramic cinematic dark-fantasy digital illustration, banner composition, 21:9. High contrast, sharp detail on wet neoprene, nylon webbing, titanium, octopus skin and calcium shell. Palette: obsidian black and slate grey shadows, deep Puget Sound teal and sea-glass green, neon magenta-violet magic light, warm sodium-orange emergency light from below. Dynamic triangular action composition sweeping left to right with clear foreground, midground and background depth.
Setting: the Seattle waterfront at Pier 59 has collapsed into a flooded underground dungeon. Shattered aquarium glass, tide pools glowing under black basalt arches, brackish Elliott Bay water pouring through a breach, wet rusted pier pilings. Through the breach high in the background, a grey rainy sky with the silhouette of the Space Needle and container cranes.
Center-left foreground, main focal point: Cordula, an athletic woman in her early thirties with a confident, focused, unflappable expression and dark hair tied back, wearing a high-visibility orange and black drysuit, a tactical float vest, neoprene combat boots and a military MOLLE load frame on her back. She braces in a low stance, swinging a long titanium touring kayak paddle with serrated steel edges on both blades. Strapped to her forearm like a round buckler shield is Chonks, a small spherical spiny lumpsucker fish, armored with bony tubercles, glaring fiercely with big black eyes.
Riding on her back inside a clear waterproof dry-bag tank mounted on the MOLLE frame, with clear tubing and two small marine bilge pumps circulating water: Barnaby, a large reddish-orange Giant Pacific Octopus, the party leader, skin flashing crimson and stark white patterns, a slim brass collar around his mantle. Two of his arms grip the overhead basalt beam to anchor Cordula, two arms lash forward to pin an attacker, and one arm releases a cloud of glowing black ink.
Center-right midground: two Deep-One Scavengers, lean reptilian fish-headed humanoids with jagged coral spears, one blinded and stumbling in the ink cloud, one pinned by octopus arms.
Right foreground: Shelly, a huge armored geoduck clam with a thick ridged pale shell, dug firmly into the flooded floor like an anchor, a steel carabiner line running from the shell to Cordula's vest, shooting a pressurized jet of seawater that knocks a scavenger back.
Subtle semi-transparent glowing violet interface boxes float in the air near the top corners, blank, with no writing. Keep the upper corners darker and calmer for overlays. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no watermark, no signature.
